senses.gloss: शिपाटक शिपाटक, अस्, m., N. of a minister.

शिपि शिपि, इस्, m. (perhaps connected with
rt. 1. शि), a ray of light; (इस्), f. skin, leather.
—शिपि-
विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose rays are displayed,
pervaded by rays; bald-headed (= खलति); leprous;
(अस्), m. epithet of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; a bald man;
a man naturally without prepuce; a leper; [cf. शिप-
विष्ट, शिविपिष्ट.]

शिप्र शिप्र, अस्, m., N. of a lake on the
high land of the Himālaya; (अम्), n., Ved. a cheek,
jaw, (अयः-शिप्र, अस्, आ, अम्, iron-jawed, having
[]
jaws of iron; having an iron visor); the chin; the
nose; a visor or helmet; (ए), n. du. the two jaws;
(आ), f. a helmet, head-dress, turban; a visor, (Sāy.
शिप्रा = उष्णीष-मयी); N. of a river issuing from
the Śipra lake.
—शिप्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having
large or handsome jaws, (Sāy. = शोभन-हनु,
Ṛg-veda VI. 17, 2); having a handsome chin,
handsome-chinned; [cf. सु-शिप्र.]

सिप्र सिप्र, अस्, m. sweat, perspiration,
heat; the moon; (आ), f. a woman's zone; a female
buffalo; N. of a river near Ujjayinī [cf. शिप्रा];
(अम्), n., N. of a lake [cf. शिप्र].

शिप्रक, अस्, m., N. of the first king of the
Āndhras.

शिप्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. having a (beautiful) cheek
or nose, handsome; having a handsome chin (said
of Indra); (इणी), f. = शिप्र; (according to modern
scholars) a draught imbibed by the mouth or jaws.
—शिप्रिणी-वत्, आन्, m., Ved. epithet of Indra (=
शिप्र-वत्).

शीपाल शीपाल, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of plant,
(Sāy. = शैवाल, Ṛg-veda X. 68, 5; cf. शेपाल.)
सिपाहण सिपाहण, N. of a place.

सीप सीप, अस्, m. a sacrificial vessel in the
shape of a boat (for making libations).
